version.description: The control exception version. The value is an integer that is represented by a string. The supported value is 1.

variables.description:
The variable exceptions. The supported values are:
  • REQUEST_COOKIES
  • REQUEST_COOKIES_NAMES
  • ARGS
  • ARGS_NAMES
  • REQUEST_HEADERS
  • REQUEST_HEADERS_NAMES
  • RESPONSE_HEADERS
  • RESPONSE_HEADERS_NAMES
  • REQUEST_URI
  • SERVER_NAMES

domains.description: The domains for the control exception. You can add up to 5 exceptions and up to 20 OWASP predefined controls per OWASP predefined control.

paths.description: The path for the control exception. You can add up to 5 exceptions and up to 20 OWASP predefined controls per OWASP predefined control.

varName.description: The variable name for the control exception.

matchType.description:
The operator for the control exception. The supported values are:
  • exact: The exception is granted only on an exact match of the value provided by the user.
  • contains: The exception is granted on any value that contains the string provided by the user.
  • beginsWith: The exception is granted only when the value starts with the string provided by the user.
  • endsWith: The exception is granted only when the value ends with the string provided by the user.

varValue.description: The value for the variable of the control exception.

matchType.description:
The operator for the control exception. The supported values are:
  • exact: The exception is granted only on an exact match of the value provided by the user.
  • contains: The exception is granted on any value that contains the string provided by the user.
  • beginsWith: The exception is granted only when the value starts with the string provided by the user.
  • endsWith: The exception is granted only when the value ends with the string provided by the user.

varValue.description: The value for the variable of the control exception.

type.description: The type of the AppProtection rule.

names.description: The names of the AppProtection rule.

conditions.description: The conditions of the AppProtection rule.

lhs.description: The key for the object type.

op.description:
The operation type. If lhs is set to SIZE, then the user can pass one of the following:
  • EQ: Equals
  • LE: Less than or equal to
  • GE: Greater than or equal to

If LHS is set to VALUE, then the user can pass one of the following:
  • CONTAINS: Denotes the control type that contains the specified rhs value.
  • STARTS_WITH: Denotes the control type that starts with the specified rhs value.
  • ENDS_WITH: Denotes the control type that ends with the specified rhs value.
  • RX: Denotes the control type with the regex of the specified rhs value.
  • EXISTS: Denotes the presence of the control type in the custom control. The EXISTS value for the OP field is only supported for the REQUEST_HEADERS, REQUEST_COOKIES, QUERY_STRING, and RESPONSE_HEADERS control types.
  • NOT_RX: Denotes the control type that does not match the regex.
  • NOT_CONTAINS: Denotes the control type that does not contain the specified rhs value.
  • NOT_STARTS_WITH: Denotes the control type that does not start with the specified rhs value.
  • NOT_ENDS_WITH: Denotes the control type that does not end with the specified rhs value.
  • NOT_EXISTS: Denotes the absence of the control type. The NOT_EXISTS value for the OP field is only supported for the REQUEST_HEADERS, REQUEST_COOKIES, QUERY_STRING, and RESPONSE_HEADERS control types.

To learn more, see Configuring AppProtection Controls Using API.

rhs.description: The value for the given object type. Its value depends upon the key.

variablesSupported.description: The supported variables for the control exception.

criteriaSupported.description: The supported criteria for the control exception.

logicalOperatorsSupported.description: The supported logical operators (i.e., AND, OR, and NOT).

operatorsSupported.description: The supported operators (i.e., exact, contains, endsWith, beginsWith).

blacklistedControlGroups.description: The predefined exceptions groups for exceptions that are not supported. Exceptions on preprocessor controls are not supported as they perform the basic sanity of an HTTP request before the request is inspected.

domainMaxLength.description: The maximum length in characters for a domain value specified by the user in the domain exceptions. The supported value is 512.

pathMaxLength.description: The maximum length in characters for a path specified by the user in the path exceptions. The supported value is 512.

valueMaxLength.description: The maximum length in characters for a VARIABLES value exception. The supported value is 512. The supported value is 512.

maxExceptionPerProfile.description: The maximum number of exceptions that can be configured per AppProtection profile on an exception set. The supported value is 20.

maxConditionsPerCriteria.description: The maximum number of exceptions that can be configured for each category (i.e. variables, domains, paths) on an exception set. The supported value is 5.
